_comment: French requests for voice-cli actions-bench. The reference time is Thursday 15 October 2026, 18:42 (--now 2026-10-15T18:42). expected.when: the date the call must carry (to the minute, or the day when no time is given; "none" = no date); end: the event's end; seconds: a timer; name: a shortcut. No expected = no action.
